note: PROD-008: Express handlers under a crmProxies prefix. The proxy is registered first, so these never run in dev; production never reaches Express at all. Each is either dead code to delete or behaviour to port into the edge function and then delete. This list only shrinks — the one exception was PROD-008b teaching the scanner to see prefix-mounted routers, which added 131 handlers it had never been able to match. That was a measurement correction, not a regression.
retainedNote: Unreachable but NOT dead: working logic with no edge counterpart and no caller, or behaviour PostgREST cannot express. Each entry states why. Retained entries do not count toward the backlog; adding one is a decision, not a default.

retained.GET /api/customers/:customerId/signature: SEC-SESSION-001 dead router, retained with its eleven siblings rather than singled out. This file reads req.session.user as its only identity and nothing assigns it, so every handler in it answers 401 in dev exactly as in production - it has never run. No client tree calls it; the e-signature surface goes to supabase/functions/signatures/ (EDGE-005e). Deleting it means deciding the fate of the whole file, which the header records as a product call.

retained.GET /api/service-tickets/:ticketId/analy: LIVE AND REACHABLE, kept by MOUNT ORDER (WF-V-01). client/src/components/service/ServiceTicketAnalysis.tsx POSTs this and it is the only implementation on either host - supabase/functions/service-tickets/ has no /:id/analysis branch. /api/service-tickets was proxied so the edge function could serve the ticket list with its equipment and technician joins, and registerServiceAnalysisRoutes(app) is now registered BEFORE registerEdgeFunctionProxy(app) in routes-registry.ts, so Express still wins this path in dev. Same fix as the inbound-webhook ordering (INTEG-WEBHOOK-001). This guard is static and cannot see mount order, which is why the entry is here rather than the route being deleted. It IS 404 in production, which is its own story.
retained.GET /api/service-tickets/:ticketId/parts: Unbuilt mobile field-service workflow: no caller on ANY host (WF-V-01). Porting them into supabase/functions/service-tickets/ is a feature story (WF-V-02 is the mobile field-service ground), not cleanup.
